Definition: from G3914; a wintering over:--winter in.
BiblicalUsage: Paracheimasia occurs once: the harbour at Fair Havens is not commodious to winter in, so the more part advise to depart thence, if by any means they might attain to Phenice and there winter.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that this one verse shows how disaster begins: a harbour judged unfit for winter, a vote to sail on, and a storm waiting beyond the point.
